verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a first-party Sandbox SDK with a broad API surface: exec with streaming output and stdin, file read/write with streams, a code interpreter with persistent contexts, sessions, file watching, preview URLs and tunnels, bucket mounts, and snapshots. The SDK also has documented transport and multiplexing architecture, so it clearly delivers an official SDK to build against. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond the JavaScript/TypeScript Workers SDK (no Python or other language SDKs shown), package/versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Sandbox SDK enables you to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments.
Multiplexes all SDK calls over a single persistent connection.
sandbox.exec() - Execute shell commands in the sandbox and capture stdout, stderr, and exit codes.
getSandbox() - Gets or creates a sandbox instance by ID. Use a stable ID to reconnect to the same sandbox.
